arabic text: NAAME ABBAS WASEELA HAI HAR DUA KE LIYE\nISME AZAM HAI YE MOMIN KI ILTEJA KE LIYE
english translation text: The name of Abbas is a means for every prayer;\nit is the greatest name for a believer's supplication.

arabic text: KOI MAANE YA NA MAANE HAI YE IMAAN MERA\nNAAM E ABBAS TO BAKHSISH KA HAI SAMAAN MERA\nCHASMA E FAIZ HAI – YEH DAR HAR IK GADA KE LIYE
english translation text: Whether anyone accepts it or not, this is my faith:\nthe name of Abbas is the means of my forgiveness.\nThis door is a fountain of grace for every beggar.

arabic text: DAR PE IK BAAR JO AAYA KABHI KHALI NA GAYA\nHO KE MAYUS KABHI KOI SAWALI NA GAYA\nDAR KHULA REHTA HAI ABBAS KA ATA KE LIYE
english translation text: Whoever came once to his door never returned empty-handed;\nno petitioner ever left disappointed.\nAbbas's door remains open for generosity.

arabic text:
BAWAFA AAPKO BEEMAR E MADINA KI QASAM
WHO JO BEEMAR HAIN KAR UN PE ZARA NAZR E
KARAM
TERE PARCHAM KI HAWA CHAHIYE SHIFA KE LIYE
english translation text:
O faithful one, by the oath of
the ailing one of Madina, look with
mercy upon those who are ill. For healing,
they need the breeze of your standard.

arabic text: JO AZADAR ZIYARAT KO TARAPTE HAIN TERI\nAAPKO WAASTA SHABBIR KA MAWLA GHAZI\nDAR PE BULWALO UNHEIN MAJLIS E AZAA KE LIYE
english translation text: Those mourners who yearn to visit you—\nby Shabbir's sake, O Maula Ghazi,\ncall them to your door for a mourning gathering.

arabic text: DEED KARTA HON ALAM PER TO QALAM RUKTA HAI\nYAAD AAAJATE HAIN GHAZI MUJHE YOO’N LAGTA HAI\nAB BHI ROTA HAI YEH ZAINAB TERI RIDA KE LIYE
english translation text: When I look upon the standard, my pen comes to a halt.\nGhazi returns to memory, and it feels\nas though Zainab still weeps for her chadar.

arabic text: ROKE KARTE HAIN YE AZLAN O KARIM EK DUA\nBEHR E ZULMAAT ME AB DOOB CHUKI HAI DUNYA\nBHEJDEIN MEHDI E DORA’N KO AB KHUDA KE LIYE
english translation text: Weeping, Azlaan and Karim make this prayer:\nthe world has sunk into an ocean of darkness.\nFor God's sake, send the Mahdi of the age.
